Short title extent and commencement

ORDINANCE XI OF 1970
ORDINANCE XI OF 1970
FINANCE ORDINANCE, 1970
1. Short title, extent and commencement.‑(1) This Ordinance
may be called the Finance Ordinance, 1970.
(2) It extends to the whole of Pakistan.
(3) Except as otherwise
provided in this Ordinance, this section and sec tions 2 and 3, clause (15) of
section 4 and clause (9) of section 6 shall come into force at once, and the
other provisions shall come into force on the first day of July 1970.
